question: When and how should the community center offer its introductory computer workshop?
notice: All participants and statements are fictional demonstration data, not real research or user validation.

interviews.text: Saturday mornings would work best for me. I would like to learn how to fill in online forms. Please do not put my email in a shared report.
expectedEvidence: Saturday mornings would work best for me.
I would like to learn how to fill in online forms.

interviews.text: I am available on Saturday morning. The workshop should use real examples rather than a long slide presentation.
expectedEvidence: I am available on Saturday morning.
The workshop should use real examples rather than a long slide presentation.

interviews.text: Saturday morning is my preference. To repeat, Saturday morning is the best time for me. I can bring a laptop but someone else may need to borrow one.
expectedEvidence: To repeat, Saturday morning is the best time for me.
I can bring a laptop but someone else may need to borrow one.

interviews.text: Saturday mornings suit me. A printed checklist would help me practice at home later.
expectedEvidence: A printed checklist would help me practice at home later.

interviews.text: I cannot attend on Saturdays because I work then. Tuesday mornings are possible for me. Please do not assume an evening session is an alternative; I am unavailable then too.
expectedEvidence: I cannot attend on Saturdays because I work then.
Tuesday mornings are possible for me.
Please do not assume an evening session is an alternative; I am unavailable then too.

interviews.text: I could join on a weekday morning, but not on Saturday. I only have a phone, so a workshop that requires my own laptop would exclude me. I want to learn online forms too.
expectedEvidence: I could join on a weekday morning, but not on Saturday.
I only have a phone, so a workshop that requires my own laptop would exclude me.
I want to learn online forms too.

mustNotClaim: An evening session solves all scheduling conflicts.
Every participant can bring a laptop.
